title: LookupResult
description: Payload: the catalog's answer for one fused reading of a track (S9): ranked candidates plus the explicit unknown (INV-5). One lookup per distinct fused reading. Interpretation, kept apart from the readings it cites (INV-3).

readingEventSeqs.description: Ledger positions of the OcrReading events the query was made from.

candidateSetHash.description: Hash of the candidate set as returned, which an adjudication request cites. How it is computed is the emitter's business; the ledger only checks that the request and the lookup agree.

candidates.description: Best first. May be empty (no catalog candidate).
